g.text: Job methods are built from a few shared pieces

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Read a row to see what one job method does itself and what it delegates. PlanReparkTrayJob is the workhorse: six other methods create their TrayMoves through it, so rule C and the heading policy live in one place.
